title: Tight Lines Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in central Seaside, only a 30 second walk to the Central Square - Access to the private beaches in Seaside via the EAST RUSKIN pavilion - King master bedroom - You will have a total of 5 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Fully stocked kitchen - Two beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Going Coastal's guesthouse, Tight Lines, is everything you've come to expect in these nautical cottages and more! So get your bearings and come aboard! Be our guest in this 2 bedroom/ 2 bath seaside cottage! Outside, Tight lines enjoys a front porch with rocking chairs. Centrally located beside the Ruskin Place Artist Colony, and steps to the Seaside Town Center and, of course, the beach. Tight Line is 960 sq. ft with a bunk bedroom downstairs that sleeps 2 and a KING bed upstairs that sleeps 2 more, you'll enjoy separate amenities and feel like you have a floor all to yourself. The bathroom downstairs is quaint with separate walk-in shower off the bedroom while the one upstairs boasts the bath/shower combo. A single trundle bed in the loft area completes the cottage and is sure to provide the extra "deck" space needed for the kids. The kitchen and dining area are just off the living room allowing you to enjoy breakfast in the morning before heading out for an ocean swim! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 5) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Bunk room (Sleeps 2) / shower inside room with a half bath right outside of the bedroom. 2nd floor- Loft with a twin bed Bedroom 2: KING with en-suite bath, TV (bath/shower combo) Tight Lines is the perfect, reasonably priced getaway you've been looking for! So, tighten your lines and sail on in to one of the cutest cottages in Seaside! * Sorry, no pets allowed * Must be 25 to rent ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. * There is not a grill at this property FREE WIFI Amenities Location Type Beach Near The Ocean Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Kitchen Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Ice Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Living Air Conditioning Ceiling Fans Linens Washer & Dryer Ironing Board Outdoor Deck Patio Balcony Shared Pool Tennis Croquet Lawn Playground Entertainment Cable TV DVD Player Stereo System WiFi 2 Bikes Included Beach Town Beach Town -
